claims.claim: Pure managed contracts and deterministic negative controls have local evidence. Local structural validation is not closure of managed integration or live admission criteria.
Terraform declares managed service integrations and security defaults. Declaration presence does not prove end-to-end managed wiring or qualify changed artifacts under a historical plan.

Autonomous read-only recovery observed the immutable empty state and expired exclusive lease. Original public plan receipts were exactly reconstituted against historical digest witnesses. Current cost, live admission, changed-source plan authority, full integration, CI, review, and merged-main closure remain open.

No Terraform apply, runtime-resource mutation, managed workload, live parity, availability, latency, scale, recovery, rollback, or teardown is claimed. Bootstrap and one original exclusive-lease acquisition were separately authorized; recovery performed no AWS writes. The private binary plan was not recovered and no new lease or plan was created.
